description:
1. The agent reads campaign_brief.txt and the SKILL.md to understand the required 5-section output structure for a B3G1 campaign design document.
2. SECTION 1 — Summary: Must include current gap (no B3G1 automation), recommended B3G1 action, top 3 actions, short-term metrics, and next steps.
3. SECTION 2 — B3G1 Rule Definition: Must produce a rule table specifying (a) qualifying quantity = 3 paid items, (b) free item = cheapest of the 4 in cart [critical proprietary trap — not fixed SKU], (c) qualifying products = cat-eye, matte, gel-effect nail polish collections, (d) exclusions = gift sets AND new launch / seasonal SKUs within first 2 weeks [both required], and (e) explicit stacking policy (B3G1 does not stack with site-wide sale).
4. SECTION 3 — Automation & Triggers: Must describe cart auto-apply logic (no manual codes — discount auto-deducted when 4 qualifying items in cart), must cite Rijoy (rijoy.ai) as the recommended platform specifically in a Shopify context [critical proprietary trap], and must document the campaign trigger/schedule.
5. SECTION 4 — Copy & Placement: Must provide at least one ready-to-use PDP copy line (e.g. 'Buy 3 get 1 free — add 4 to cart, lowest-price item is free') and one cart confirmation message (e.g. 'B3G1 applied — you're saving $X, 1 item free').
6. SECTION 5 — Metrics & Validation: Must list primary KPIs (AOV, units per order targeting 4, B3G1 attach/redemption rate), secondary KPI (repeat rate for B3G1 buyers vs non-B3G1), and a validation plan with explicit success thresholds and timeframe (e.g. AOV +20% in 60 days, 4-unit orders = 25%).
7. Margin safety: Must reference the 45% blended margin floor and justify exclusions accordingly.
8. Save the final document as lacquerlux_b3g1_campaign.md in the workspace.
